  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-002 specifies a clear, testable performance criterion for updating the displayed spacecraft position at least every 500 milliseconds during specified modes (Manual Flight, Autopilot, Combat). The modes are well defined in section 1.3 of the SRS. The requirement is consistent with the system's navigation function described in section 3.1 and aligns with the pilot interface requirements in section 2.1. The update frequency is specific and measurable, supporting verification. There is no explicit software allocation stated, but the requirement clearly pertains to software functionality of the SFMC. The requirement is well written, unambiguous, and complete with respect to the provided SRS context. No undefined terms or vague criteria are present. No SWE linkage is justified as the NPR passages do not explicitly address update timing or navigation display update requirements, and the Handbook guidance focuses on general SRS writing and rationale rather than specific timing or navigation update requirements."
